_note: Astro's spending rules and the order wallet's release rules. Read by seed/astro.ts and engine/escrow.ts; the worker in worker/release-gate enforces the same rules inside the enclave.

commercial_terms._note: The trade terms the 50/44 settlement assumes. Part of the rules hash every approver signs (convex/approvalTerms.ts RULES_HASH).
commercial_terms.incoterm: DAP Chicago (supplier carries transit risk until delivery at Astro's dock)
commercial_terms.advance: 30% on bill of lading and export clearance; an advance larger than the value later delivered is a claim against the supplier, settled off-chain (the order wallet cannot claw back a payout)
commercial_terms.balance: received units x unit price, minus the advance, on import clearance and a dock count signed by Astro's dock device
commercial_terms.short_shipment: units not delivered are cancelled, not backordered; their share returns to Astro; a backorder is a new PO with new approvals
commercial_terms.deadline: anything still held at the deadline returns to Astro
